source.title: Keeping It Cool: Much Orbit Migration, yet Little Heating, in the Galactic Disk

population.description: Milky Way low-alpha disk, fit to APOGEE DR14 red-clump stars with Gaia DR2 phase-space information

angular_momentum_diffusion.equation: p(Lz | Lz0, tau) proportional to exp(-(Lz-Lz0-D*tau)^2 / (2*sigma_Lz^2*tau/tau_m)), normalized for Lz>0
angular_momentum_diffusion.interpretation: global effective diffusion in angular momentum; coefficients assumed independent of Lz and sigma independent of time
angular_momentum_diffusion.derived_migration_distance_kpc: approximately 2.6 * sqrt(tau/6 Gyr) for vcirc about 235 km/s
angular_momentum_diffusion.earlier_Frankel2018_total_orbit_migratio: approximately 3.6 * sqrt(tau/8 Gyr), combining churning and blurring

stage7_use.status: candidate statistical source-history evolution operator, not an individual-star trajectory product
stage7_use.permitted_use: Can propagate a birth angular-momentum/radius population probabilistically through time within the model's low-alpha and approximate age/radius validity domain.
not_permitted_without_new_justification: Treating a diffusion realization as the literal trajectory of an individual observed star
Extrapolating the calibrated law unchanged to the oldest high-alpha disk beyond the approximately 6 Gyr fitted age domain
Using it as an azimuthal or resonance-resolved history
Interpreting it as a baryonic current-history J_b(x,t), because the model is one-dimensional in angular momentum and does not supply phi(t), z(t), or velocity-current history

key_caveats_from_paper: Migration is inferred indirectly through age-metallicity-dynamics structure under a tight birth chemistry assumption.
The diffusion coefficient is treated as a global mean and is not allowed to vary with radius or time.
The migration and heating prescriptions are treated separately although real perturbations can couple them.
The paper explicitly notes that the model lacks the full source term inside the diffusion equation and models star formation separately.
